title: The per-command help guards inside the switch (claude's `if (parsed.help)`, plu…
description:
The per-command help guards inside the switch (claude's `if (parsed.help)`, plus config/triage) are now unreachable-for-help dead code since the central guard returns first. Left in place deliberately per Surgical Changes; a future cleanup story could strip them.

Source: cam/issue-211
Review round: 1
Location: index.ts:2407

suggestion-fingerprint: fded210f82c6

spec.scope: Strip the three per-command --help guard blocks that became dead-for-help after the CAM-211 central --help guard: the config, claude, and triage switch cases. Remove ONLY the help blocks; keep all surrounding non-help logic. Cleanup only, no behavior change. Rebase on CAM-278's restructured switch.
acceptanceCriteria: The three dead-for-help blocks are removed: config's `if (tail.includes('--help') || tail.includes('-h'))` (index.ts:2258-2262), claude's `if (parsed.help)` (index.ts:2458-2462), and triage's `if (tail.includes('--help') || tail.includes('-h'))` (index.ts:2529-2532).

All surrounding non-help logic is preserved: config's --show parsing and unknown-flag error (index.ts:2263-2270); claude's parseClaudeArgs(...) call (index.ts:2458, whose parsed.forwardedArgs is consumed by runClaude at index.ts:2463); triage's tail-length error check and dispatchTriage() (index.ts:2533-2538).

Behavior is unchanged and verified: `cam config --help`, `cam claude --help` and `cam claude -h` (leading), and `cam triage --help` still print their help via the central guard; a non-leading --help passed to claude is still forwarded to the child process. Confirm each by running it.
bun run typecheck, bun test, bun run check:all all green.
gotchas: Do NOT remove the parseClaudeArgs(...) call in the claude case: only the `if (parsed.help){...}` block is dead; parsed.forwardedArgs is still consumed by runClaude (index.ts:2463).
Do NOT remove config's --show parsing/unknown-flag error or triage's tail-error + dispatchTriage() call: only the help conditionals are strippable.
This is blockedBy CAM-278: land 278 first (Command union + narrowing + exhaustive default), then strip these guards on top of the restructured switch to avoid a same-region rebase conflict.

The central guard (index.ts:2202-2213) already covers all three commands identically (anywhere-in-tail for config/triage, leading-only for claude); verify by running each --help after stripping rather than assuming.
